title: Core Web Vitals: LCP, INP and CLS

videos.script:
A person does not feel a load time. They feel three things. Is it there yet. Does it answer when I touch it. Does it hold still while I read. {{three}} Google gives each of those a number: LCP, INP and CLS. This lesson defines each one well enough to reason about it, and then measures them in the planner.

{{measure}} You will add a small library that measures them inside the page, as a visitor's browser lives through them. {{notice}} Then a notice arrives late, on a phone-sized window, and the page jumps. You will keep room for it, and then send it with the page, and watch both numbers move.

{{click}} Then a click that takes two seconds to show anything, with a catalogue of five thousand courses. Two fixes, measured one after the other.

{{field}} And last, the number that matters: the one from the visitor. The page sends its values home when the person leaves.
